subject.title: Dependabot semanal + autofix de CI con agente

question: Should Hamelyn accept the privileged Dependabot autofix design from https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/pull/6525, split it, or narrow the scope to Dependabot scheduling only?
rationale: The requested autofix workflow would run after CI failure and push commits using repository secrets, so automation cannot safely decide the permanent trigger and credential model.

options.title: Review linked workflow PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/pull/6525 as the canonical implementation after conflicts and secret-boundary proof are resolved.

options.title: Split schedule from autofix
options.body: Land the weekly Dependabot config first and keep the agent autofix as a separate security-reviewed workflow PR.

options.title: Dependabot only
options.body: Decline the agent autofix for now and rely on weekly dependency PRs plus the existing lockfile autofix workflow.

recommendation.title: Review linked workflow PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/pull/6525 as the canonical implementation after conflicts and secret-boundary proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn has the strongest recent history in CI/workflow automation and is already requested on the linked implementation PR.
